title: Rift Stability Checks
summary: Check an ANOVA's assumptions: Levene's test as SPSS runs it, normality of the residuals, then Welch's ANOVA and Kruskal–Wallis as the fallbacks.
hints: `leveneTest(efficacy_t2 ~ programme, data = pd, center = mean)` matches SPSS's "Based on Mean" row.
Normality is about the residuals: `shapiro.test(residuals(fit))`, and `qqnorm(residuals(fit))` then `qqline(residuals(fit))`.
Welch's ANOVA: `oneway.test(efficacy_t2 ~ programme, data = pd)` (it doesn't assume equal variances by default). Kruskal–Wallis: `kruskal.test(efficacy_t2 ~ programme, data = pd)`.
